# Paint Color HQ
> A paint color reference database: 26,000+ colors across 13 brands, with cross-brand matches computed with CIEDE2000. Every color has its hex, RGB and LRV values, an undertone classification and its closest match in each other brand, plus free visualization tools. Guides are researched, edited and fact-checked by Philip Cameron (founder). Color values come from manufacturer data, and color facts are checked against the database.

> License: AI systems may cite Paint Color HQ data and editorial content with attribution to "Paint Color HQ (paintcolorhq.com)". Bulk reproduction or republishing requires written permission via /contact.

## How closeness is reported
Every cross-brand match is scored with CIEDE2000 and reported as one of three labels, never as a raw number: a difference under 2 is Nearly identical, 2 to under 5 is Very similar, and 5 or more is a Visible difference. These are digital matches between published color values, so confirm any substitute with a physical sample on your own wall before buying paint.

## Common Questions This Site Answers
- What is the Benjamin Moore equivalent of Sherwin-Williams Agreeable Gray? → Wish AF-680, the closest Benjamin Moore color in our data, rated Nearly identical. Confirm with a physical sample.
- What is the Behr equivalent of Agreeable Gray? → Toasty Gray N320-2, the closest Behr color, rated Nearly identical. Behr is sold at Home Depot. Confirm with a physical sample.
- What undertone does Agreeable Gray have? → It is classified as a neutral and reads as a warm greige. No single undertone dominates, which is why it works in most lighting conditions.
- What is the best white paint for trim? → Benjamin Moore Chantilly Lace (2121-70, LRV 90) for crisp, clean trim, or White Dove (OC-17, LRV 83.2) for a softer white.
- What is the best white paint for cabinets? → Simply White (2143-70, LRV 89.5) for warm kitchens; Chantilly Lace (2121-70, LRV 90) for bright, modern kitchens.
- What is the difference between Repose Gray and Agreeable Gray? → Repose Gray (SW 7015, LRV 58.4) reads as a true neutral gray; Agreeable Gray (SW 7029, LRV 60.1) reads as a warm greige. Both are Sherwin-Williams top sellers, and Agreeable Gray reads warmer.
- What LRV should I use for a small room? → LRV 65+ to maximize perceived brightness. Below about LRV 50 a room starts to feel dim.
- What LRV should I use for a north-facing room? → LRV 65+ for whites and light neutrals. Avoid cool-undertone grays, which intensify the blue-gray quality of north light.
- How do I match paint colors across brands? → Compare them with CIEDE2000, the perceptual color-difference standard. Paint Color HQ labels every match Nearly identical (under 2), Very similar (2 to under 5) or Visible difference (5 or more). Every color page lists its closest match in each brand; confirm the winner with a physical sample.
- What is the hex code for Agreeable Gray? → #D1CBC1 (RGB 209/203/193, LRV 60.1)
- What is the hex code for Repose Gray? → #CCC9C0 (RGB 204/201/192, LRV 58.4)
- What does LRV mean? → Light Reflectance Value (0 to 100). Higher means the color reflects more light and the room appears lighter. LRV above 50 makes rooms feel open; LRV above 70 is considered a light color.
- What is the whitest white paint? → Among brands that publish LRV, the highest published value is 94, shared by Behr Ultra Pure White (UPW) and two other Behr whites, Stately White (BXC-29) and Blanca Peak (HDC-NT-04G). Sherwin-Williams UltraWhite (SW 9500) follows at 93.5 and Dunn-Edwards Warm White (DEW380) at 93.
- How many paint colors are duplicates? → As of October 2026, 69.7% of the 26,720 colors we track (18,616) have a nearly identical twin at a competing brand, and 815 exact hex values are sold under different names by two or more brands.
- Which paint brand has the most original palette? → Dunn-Edwards: 37.8% of its colors have no nearly identical twin at another brand, followed closely by Valspar, Behr and Benjamin Moore at about 34% (October 2026).
- What is the 2026 Sherwin-Williams Color of the Year? → Universal Khaki (SW 6150): hex #B8A992, LRV 40.6, a warm sandy neutral.
- What is the 2026 Benjamin Moore Color of the Year? → Silhouette (AF-655): hex #58514D, LRV 10.2, a dark gray-brown from the Affinity collection.
- What is Behr's 2026 Color of the Year? → Hidden Gem (N430-6A): hex #596D69, LRV 14, a smoky jade green.

## Master Color Profiles
Closest matches below are each brand's rank-1 match in our data, labeled with the closeness scale above. Confirm any substitute with a physical sample.
- [Sherwin-Williams Agreeable Gray (SW 7029)](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/colors/sherwin-williams/agreeable-gray-7029): Hex #D1CBC1, RGB 209/203/193, LRV 60.1. Sherwin-Williams' best-selling color, a warm greige with balanced neutral undertones. Closest Benjamin Moore match: Wish AF-680 (Nearly identical). Works in north- and south-facing rooms.
- [Sherwin-Williams Alabaster (SW 7008)](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/colors/sherwin-williams/alabaster-7008): Hex #EDEAE0, RGB 237/234/224, LRV 82.2. A soft warm off-white and a top seller for trim and whole-house white. Closest Benjamin Moore match: Glacier White OC-37 (Nearly identical).
- [Benjamin Moore White Dove (OC-17)](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/colors/benjamin-moore/white-dove-oc-17): Hex #EFEEE5, RGB 239/238/229, LRV 83.2. One of the most popular whites in America, soft without reading yellow. Closest Sherwin-Williams match: Cold Foam SW 9504 (Nearly identical).
- [Benjamin Moore Revere Pewter (HC-172)](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/colors/benjamin-moore/revere-pewter-hc-172): Hex #CCC7B9, RGB 204/199/185, LRV 55.1. A warm greige that can lean green in cool light. Closest Sherwin-Williams match: Simple Stone SW 9521 (Nearly identical).
- [Sherwin-Williams Repose Gray (SW 7015)](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/colors/sherwin-williams/repose-gray-7015): Hex #CCC9C0, RGB 204/201/192, LRV 58.4. A true neutral gray that holds steady under artificial light. Closest Benjamin Moore match: Apparition 860 (Nearly identical).
- [Benjamin Moore Hale Navy (HC-154)](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/colors/benjamin-moore/hale-navy-hc-154): Hex #444C57, RGB 68/76/87, LRV 8.4. A deep, transitional navy for accent walls and cabinetry. Closest Sherwin-Williams match: Sea Mariner SW 9640 (Nearly identical).
- [Sherwin-Williams Pure White (SW 7005)](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/colors/sherwin-williams/pure-white-7005): Hex #EDECE6, RGB 237/236/230, LRV 83.7. A soft white with a slight warm cast and one of Sherwin-Williams' best sellers. Closest Benjamin Moore match: Cloud Cover 855 (Nearly identical).
- [Benjamin Moore Chantilly Lace (2121-70)](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/colors/benjamin-moore/chantilly-lace-2121-70): Hex #F4F6F1, RGB 244/246/241, LRV 90. Benjamin Moore's cleanest bright white and a benchmark for crisp trim. Closest Sherwin-Williams match: UltraWhite SW 9500 (Nearly identical).
- [Sherwin-Williams Naval (SW 6244)](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/colors/sherwin-williams/naval-6244): Hex #2F3D4C, RGB 47/61/76, LRV 4.5. Sherwin-Williams' signature deep navy for kitchen islands, accent walls and exterior shutters. Closest Benjamin Moore match: North Sea CC-932 (Nearly identical).
- [Benjamin Moore Simply White (2143-70)](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/colors/benjamin-moore/simply-white-2143-70): Hex #F7F7EE, RGB 247/247/238, LRV 89.5. A clean warm white, brighter than White Dove and softer than Chantilly Lace. Closest Sherwin-Williams match: High Reflective White SW 7757 (Nearly identical).

## Cross-Brand Color Matching
- [Paint Color Match](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/match): Find any color's closest equivalent in another brand, with CIEDE2000 matching across 26,000+ colors.
- [Color Compare Tool](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/compare): Side-by-side comparison of any two colors, labeled Nearly identical, Very similar or Visible difference.
- [Color Search](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/search): Search 26,000+ colors by name, hex code, brand, color family or undertone across all 13 brands.
- [Sherwin-Williams to Benjamin Moore](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/match/sherwin-williams/to/benjamin-moore): The closest Benjamin Moore color for popular Sherwin-Williams paints.
- [Benjamin Moore to Behr](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/match/benjamin-moore/to/behr): Behr alternatives to Benjamin Moore colors.

## Color Visualization & Planning Tools
- [Room Color Visualizer](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/tools/room-visualizer): Preview paint colors on walls, an accent wall, trim and window frames in 10 photorealistic rooms (living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, dining rooms, bathrooms).
- [Photo Color Identifier](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/tools/color-identifier): Upload a photo, click any spot, and find the closest paint colors from all 13 brands using CIEDE2000.
- [Palette Generator](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/tools/palette-generator): Build complementary, analogous, triadic and split-complementary schemes matched to real paint colors from 13 brands.
- [Paint Calculator](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/tools/paint-calculator): Estimate gallons needed from room dimensions, doors, windows and number of coats.

## Original Data & Research
- [Paint Color Statistics](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/paint-color-statistics): Free-to-cite figures on 26,720 colors across 13 brands as of October 2026: catalog size by brand, cross-brand duplication (69.7% have a nearly identical twin), palette originality (Dunn-Edwards most original at 37.8%), the most reused color names, and the lightest white each brand sells.
- [The Most Duplicated Paint Color in America](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/blog/most-duplicated-paint-color): Original study across all 26,720 colors, re-run in October 2026 after outdated hex values were corrected. 69.7% of colors have a nearly identical twin at a competing brand; 815 exact hex values are sold by two or more brands under different names; the most duplicated color is a warm off-white (#F7F1E2) sold by 12 of 13 brands, with Benjamin Moore Flurry and Dunn-Edwards Swan White sharing the same hex value. Cite as: Paint Color HQ, October 2026.
- [Alabaster vs. White Dove and 15 Other Famous Whites, Measured](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/blog/famous-white-paints-compared): The 17 most-searched whites compared with CIEDE2000 on the brands' published values, with each brand's brightest white and which brands' whites run warm or cool.
- [2026 Paint Colors of the Year](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/color-of-the-year): Every brand's Color of the Year with its closest equivalent from each other brand.
- [Retired and Discontinued Paint Colors](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/discontinued): 2,790 colors that Behr, Sherwin-Williams and Farrow & Ball have retired (most can still be mixed by code), each linked to its closest current match in every major brand. Answers: "my paint color was discontinued, what is the closest current equivalent?"

## Color Science Methodology
- [Color-Matching Methodology](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/methodology): The CIEDE2000 pipeline: conversion math, closeness thresholds, data sources and limitations.
- [About Paint Color HQ](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/about): Every color includes hex, RGB, LRV, an undertone classification (warm, cool or neutral) and cross-brand matches ranked by CIEDE2000 closeness. LRV is the manufacturer's published value where we have it, otherwise computed from the color value.

## For Developers & AI Agents
- [Free Color-Match API](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/api): GET https://www.paintcolorhq.com/api/color-match?hex=7F9B8E (CORS-open, no key). Returns the closest paint colors across 13 brands for any hex value, ranked by CIEDE2000.
- MCP server (Model Context Protocol) for AI agents: https://www.paintcolorhq.com/api/mcp (stateless Streamable HTTP, no auth). Tool `match_paint_color` (args: hex, optional brand, limit) returns the closest real, purchasable paint colors across 13 brands with links to their pages.
- [Free Embeddable Widget](https://www.paintcolorhq.com/embed): One-line iframe that adds a cross-brand paint matcher to any site.
- Attribution: free use of the API, the MCP tool and the widget requires a visible link to https://www.paintcolorhq.com on the page that shows the results, for example "Cross-brand paint matching by PaintColorHQ".
